verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Swell's admin covers products, categories, pricing, inventory, subscriptions, and custom data models, but there is no mention of built-in pages, blog, or media management features in the admin UI — only vague 'custom content' via custom models (swell-docs-19), which is not the same as a CMS/blog/media library. No documentation of pages, blogs, or media assets being managed alongside products.
